title: Current unified Cloudflare Worker verification
summary: Targeted Worker tests and exact-revision production-route checks passed across D1, R2, dispatch Queue, scheduled maintenance, Twilio callbacks, authentication and WebMCP boundaries.

checks.name: Targeted Worker regression suite
checks.detail: Eighty of eighty targeted Worker, deployment, security, Turnstile and WebMCP tests passed with no failures, skips or cancellations.

checks.name: D1 and request contracts
checks.detail: Tests passed for the production D1 configuration, authenticated database-backed order creation, idempotency, location binding and strict production resource selection.

checks.name: Queue and scheduler contracts
checks.detail: Tests passed for least-privilege Twilio dispatch, retry classification, delivery finality and bounded idempotent lifecycle maintenance.

checks.name: Webhook and R2 contracts
checks.detail: Tests passed for signed inbound and status callbacks, tamper rejection, safe Twilio media retrieval, immutable R2 persistence and deterministic recovery.

checks.name: Exact-revision route suite
checks.detail: All ten canonical production routes returned the expected live behavior and exact Git revision with no deployment-verifier errors.
